subject: special-vault-treasure-island
purpose: Phone-sized 3D special island lab for a future HabitGame Island Run treasure collection island.

singleViewLimits: Interior vault room is inferred from the source theme and generated reference sheet.
Final board-art camera and live Island Run board composition are not approved yet.
